commits.summary: Layout: page/spread geometry, text frames, threaded reflow with overset, first-fit and Knuth-Plass breakers (compiles, clippy clean)
Layout: 5 hand-computed focused tests, layout-consumer example, Knuth-Plass boundary tolerance, -0 sum normalisation

capabilities_done: geometry.rs: Margins/Page/Spread (facing pages left to right, spread coordinates)/TextFrame (spread+page ref, inset, explicit first baseline, obstacle rects)/Rect, all lengths _pt

paragraph.rs: LayoutGlyph/ShapedParagraph (from_type flattens a Type ParagraphResult; from_fixed_advance toy fixture), break_opportunities via unicode-linebreak UAX #14, box/glue/penalty items (hanging trailing space, forced breaks, in-word opportunities after hyphen)

breaker.rs: Composer::FirstFit (greedy single-line) and Composer::KnuthPlass(KnuthPlassParams): badness 100|r|^3 capped 10000, demerits (line_penalty+b)^2 with penalty term, 4 fitness classes + adjacent-class demerits, per-(line,class) candidates, 3 passes (tolerance 200, 10000, overfull allowed), varying per-line widths, fallback to first-fit

threaded_reflow.rs: reflow(ReflowRequest, &CancellationToken) -> LayoutProposal {base_revision, frames[FramePlacement{lines[Line]}], overset: exact first unplaced byte .. story end}; obstacle-narrowed line slots (widest gap), blocked baselines skipped; deterministic (no hashing)

Typed refusals: StaleRevision, CyclicThread, InvalidGeometry, InvalidInput, MissingFont, UnsupportedComposition (RTL, non-Latn/Zyyy), BudgetExceeded (lines, glyphs, paragraphs, slot scans), Canceled; DESCRIPTOR; report() -> one Observe terminal outcome; example layout-consumer

tests.clippy_tests_examples: PASS no layout warnings (type crate emits its own pre-existing warnings)
tests.oracle: toy font 6 pt/glyph, 60 pt line; Knuth-Plass example 'aa bb cc dd ee fffff' hand-computed (single feasible pass-1 breaking, r=-1, demerits 12100+100) and cross-checked against an independent Python enumeration of all breakings; first-fit gives 3 lines instead
tests.not_proven: from_type was compile-checked against hsk-studio-type's public API but NOT run on a real Type ParagraphResult (needs the ~1300 LOC Type test ports/fonts; not replicated); no InDesign oracle; RTL/CJK only refused, never laid out

dep_requests: unicode-linebreak 0.1.5 (UAX #14) appended to builders/dep-requests.jsonl; Cargo.lock updated locally by cargo (not staged); resolved version 0.1.5 confirmed by the lock
folio_additions_needed: Text frame object (spec STU-LAY-018/122): schema + id for a text frame carrying spread/page ref, bounds in document unit (folio Length), inset, first-baseline settings, wrap/obstacle refs (STU-LAY-024/126), auto-size and vertical justification (STU-LAY-118..121)

Thread contract fields on the frame (STU-LAY-122): parent_story, start_text_frame, end_text_frame, previous_text_frame, next_text_frame, text_frame_index, overflows (bool); cyclic/duplicate thread validation to live beside folio's existing cycle checks
Page/spread model: folio StudioPageSpread has only name/parent/bounds; layout needs a pages list with per-page width/height/margins (and master/section later) inside the spread

Story primitive link: folio Payload::Text{story_id} exists, but there is no StudioTextStory content/paragraph/style contract for layout to read; layout currently takes caller-supplied ShapedParagraph + story text
Overset result: a place to record the overset span/overflows flag as derived state (not authored) once the frame object lands
Layout keeps its frame/thread model crate-local (TextFrame, thread: &[usize]) until the lead decides these
decisions_for_lead: SourceSpan is layout-local (u64 byte range, From<type::SourceRange>) so layout's public types stay plain for components/interop-layout
Hanging trailing whitespace belongs to the line's glyph range (ranges tile the paragraph exactly) but not to width_pt; hang_pt reports it
Empty paragraph occupies one empty line; no space before/after paragraphs; left-aligned only (no justification/hyphenation/columns) in this slice
Relation of this Knuth-Plass to the Adobe Paragraph Composer is UNVERIFIED (research/adobe-behavior.md)
Brief lists src/threaded_reflow.rs + src/paragraph.rs + tests/threaded_reflow.rs: matched; extra files geometry.rs and breaker.rs added by this slice
next: Independent validator round on the pushed HEAD for crates/hsk-studio-layout: tests/threaded_reflow first. Later scope: nib WrapProvider contour wrap, columns, justification/hyphenation, a real Type end-to-end test through from_type.
